title: Pink Halloween Coffee Bar
description: Create a pink Halloween coffee corner with a ghost mug, heart-shaped stand, mini velvet pumpkins, silver disco balls and LED tea lights.
intro: Halloween, but the kind you can look at before your first coffee. A smiling pink ghost mug, velvet pumpkins, tiny mirror balls and a heart-shaped stand that keeps all of it in one spot instead of all over the counter. Five finds, styled around the coffee setup you already have.

sections.heading: Your morning coffee, with a little haunt
paragraphs: The ghost mug is the first thing you notice. Rounded body, little side arms, a smile, and it is pink, so it sits fine next to your everyday dishes. Give it its own spot beside the machine with the face pointed at the room. If it hides behind a pile of decorations, you bought a ghost mug for nothing.

Clear a small stretch of counter first. The machine, the water tank and the spot where you set your cup down stay easy to reach, and the decorating goes next to that, not on top of it. If your coffee setup is one shelf or a tray, same idea, smaller. One mug and a handful of details is plenty.

The mug is pink ceramic and recorded at 14 ounces. Check the current listing for size and care before you buy, and trust the retailer's photos over mine for the exact shape and shade, because these images are styling inspiration.

sections.heading: Make the heart stand the centerpiece
paragraphs: The two-tier heart stand is what makes this look like a display instead of clutter. Set it to one side of the coffee area with the hearts facing forward. The pink ceramic matches the mug, and the gold-colored rod and heart-loop handle keep it from being pink on pink on pink. Everything seasonal goes on the stand, not across the counter.

A few velvet pumpkins go on the bottom tier and a little group of disco balls on top. Leave some plate showing. That pink rim is part of the look, and the gaps let the textures do their thing: soft velvet, smooth ceramic, mirrored silver. Tallest pumpkin at the back, small ones up front.

The plates are recorded at nine inches on the bottom and seven on top. Measure your counter, including the room you need to lift the stand or reach around it, and check those numbers against the listing. The pumpkins and disco balls come in multipacks, and you do not need all of them in one corner. The spares can go on a shelf.

sections.heading: Velvet pumpkins, tiny mirrors and pink light
paragraphs: The pumpkins come in blush, coral pink, peach and ivory, which keeps the whole thing from turning into one solid block of pink. Put two shades next to each other and let the little gold-colored stems show. One pumpkin by the mug ties both halves of the counter together without stealing your cup spot.

A few mini disco balls are the contrast to all that velvet. Keep them on the stand, away from the counter edge, so they are not rolling around your coffee station. The silver is enough of a statement. The flowers and artwork in the picture are styling extras, not more things to buy.

Finish with a few pink LED tea lights near the base. The white flame-shaped tips are plastic LEDs, not real candle flames. Keep the lights away from splashes and follow their product instructions. The goal is a small pool of seasonal detail around the display, with a clear patch of counter beside it.

sections.heading: Make the corner yours, then enjoy it
paragraphs: The last photo is the real test: me, the mug in use, the stand beside it and room to move. Do the same check at home. Make a drink, grab your supplies, set the mug down. If you had to move a pumpkin to do it, that pumpkin comes off the counter.

Bring in a favorite coaster, a folded towel or a frame you already own if it suits your space. The pictured machine, cabinetry, flowers, mirrors, artwork, canisters, cookies and coffee-pod cauldron belong to the setting. They are separate from the five selected finds: the mug, heart stand, velvet pumpkins, LED tea lights and mini disco balls.

For a smaller version, start with the mug, a couple of pumpkins and the tea lights. For the full look, let the heart stand carry it and keep the rest of the counter clear. Same coffee routine, just with a little pink Halloween company.
